items.title: Meta spend 2026-10-27: $50.92, 4 leads, CPL $12.73
items.summary: Flooring Problems Campaign was the only campaign that spent: $50.92 CAD, 1,472 impressions, 41 clicks, 4 leads at $12.73 CPL, against a 7-day CPL of about $20.96 ($356.40 spend, 17 leads, 2026-10-21 to 10-27). No delivery or disapproval problems.

needs_attention: No prior meta-ads.json found in the last 7 days of ingest/, so the gap since the last run is unknown. The 7-day pull (2026-10-21 to 10-27) was used as the baseline and shows no gaps in delivery. Metrics cover 2026-10-27 only.
